item.title: Publishing a New Python Script: Recode Stamper
item.description:
I’ve just published a new Python project on GitHub: recode-stamper.

The idea is simple: turn a UTF-8 string into a mnemonic phrase and convert it back later, using a structured 12- or 24-word encoding format.
